en: Colorized panoramic view of a European town seen from a flowered meadow in the foreground. The town has many red‑tiled roofs, industrial buildings with a tall brick chimney, a church with a slender tower, and a large castle‑like complex on a hill. Trees and greenery surround the buildings, and the landscape extends into gently rolling fields in the distance. The word "Zschopau." appears printed in red at the top left.
